parsed_json.up: Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL376359 to include the parent and all salts. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then compound_records.record_id to activities.record_id, and docs through compound_records.doc_id. Join assays via activities.assay_id and target_dictionary via assays.tid. Filter for target CHEMBL284 and IC50 activities with standard_units nM. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Do not limit rows.
